_about: Fossil snakes: the age of the youngest well-dated fossil and the countries the fossils come from, from the Paleobiology Database (https://paleobiodb.org, occurrences of the taxon - its own name or a recombination of it) or, where noted, the original description. Only filled in where SnakeList had no age or no countries; ages from other sources are kept. 'age' is [epoch, million years ago]: the middle of the youngest dated occurrence's interval (occurrences dated only to a span of more than 8 million years are not used). Applied to the app by tools/fossil_pbdb.py.
